name: sitemap-url-extractor
title: Sitemap URL Extractor: Every URL of a Site for Audits
description: Get every URL of a site for an SEO or AI audit, or to feed a crawler. Finds the sitemaps from robots.txt, follows sitemap indexes and .gz files, and returns each page URL with lastmod, priority, hreflang and an optional HTTP status. Filter by regex or date. Step 1 before a broken-link check or a PageSpeed run. Export CSV, Excel or JSON, or run from the API.
seoTitle: Sitemap URL Extractor: Get Every URL of a Site
seoDescription: Get every URL of a site for an SEO or AI audit, or to feed a crawler. Reads sitemaps, indexes and .gz files, with lastmod and optional HTTP status.
